name: CroasterWebUi
description: Browser UI served by the board for Croaster: monitoring, live roast chart and (on boards with the control add-on) controls. web/ holds the readable page sources; embed_assets.py gzips them into src/webui_assets.h at build time. src/WebUiServer serves them with ESP-IDF esp_http_server; the page talks to Croaster's existing WebSocket on port 81.
